summary: School expresses support for preserving E-Rate funding to ensure connectivity for instruction and security.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would lose critical connectivity for instruction and security
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, our instruction would be cut short; for many students, the audio available through our online resources is vital. We also depend on it for security - without it, our Safe School Officer would not be able to respond to any concerns or suspicious figures as immediately.
